rationale.usefulness: One validated operator number: the 41-turn cap costs about a tenth of committed work (2.5-13% per period, matching H44), and the memory write does not recover it; levers are a longer cap or carrying task state across the wipe. Still scaffold engineering more than swarm physics.

one_line: Losing memory (or switching repo) costs nothing visible in a day; a forced context wipe costs ~39% of committed work for 10 calls, whatever the agent saves to memory
